title: What is Angular?
description: The web development framework for building modern apps.

blocks.text: Angular is a web development framework developed and maintained by Google and a worldwide community of contributors. It provides a cohesive, scalable solution for building high-performance web applications with first-class TypeScript support.

items.title: Essentials
items.body: A comprehensive tour of the developer experience, introducing core concepts such as Components, Templates, and Signals.

items.title: Tutorials
items.body: Step-by-step interactive coding tutorials directly in your browser, from your very first app to advanced features.

blocks.text: Angular provides an integrated suite of tools and modern primitives that empower developers to focus on product logic:

items.title: Components
items.body: Encapsulate TypeScript logic, HTML templates, and CSS styles into clean, modular building blocks.

items.title: Signals Reactivity
items.body: Fine-grained reactivity model that tracks state changes precisely and updates the UI with optimal rendering efficiency.

items.title: Dependency Injection (DI)
items.body: Industry-leading DI framework that makes your application highly modular, extensible, and easy to unit test.

items.title: Server-side Rendering (SSR)
items.body: Built-in server rendering and non-destructive hydration to dramatically improve initial page load and SEO.

blocks.text: Angular operates on a predictable 6-month release cadence. The `ng update` CLI command provides automated migrations to keep codebases up to date effortlessly.

items.title: Validated on Google's Monorepo
items.body: Every Angular code commit is automatically validated against hundreds of thousands of internal Google projects.

items.title: Next-Gen Tooling (Vite + esbuild)
items.body: Instant server startup powered by Vite and blazing-fast production builds with esbuild, plus Angular DevTools profiling.
